recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future NPI identifier metadata corrections should be handled through THO/TSMG rather than by restoring removed core registry bundle content.
issue_request: FHIR-8047 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request from DSTU1 asking FHIR core to add a system URI for the US National Provider Identifier, with resolution http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-npi.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn revision 6064, represented in git by c8797d9ce12b17c991437850da507680fa9e7a45, which added a United States National Provider Identifier NamingSystem registry entry with URI http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-npi and OID 2.16.840.1.113883.4.6.
additional_context: FHIR-37889 later removed the core NamingSystem registry bundles because this content is authoritatively maintained in HL7 Terminology. Current core source keeps the identifier registry page in the build hierarchy and directs implementers to terminology.hl7.org; the current THO package contains active NamingSystem/npi with the requested URI as a preferred identifier, and current core examples use that URI.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core edit is needed because restoring the retired in-core NamingSystem registry entry would conflict with the later THO migration, while the authoritative external registry already contains the requested NPI URI.

related_jiras.note: Removed core NamingSystem registry bundles in favor of authoritative THO content, governing why the old core entry should not be restored.
Unresolved HTA request about improving the CMS link for the THO NPI identifier; not a final core source decision.
Later Practitioner example work uses the same NPI URI in current core examples but does not change the registry decision.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive PA change request asking for a US NPI system URI, resolved as http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-npi.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final requested identifier system URI for the reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: Historical application commit for svn revision 6064 added the us-npi NamingSystem registry entry with the requested URI and OID 2.16.840.1.113883.4.6.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-8047 was applied in the old in-core identifier registry.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue and implementation removed core NamingSystem registry bundles because THO is the authoritative, actively maintained source.
evidence_items.learned: The absence of an in-core us-npi registry entry is intentional and should not be reversed for FHIR-8047.

evidence_items.summary: The current built identifier registry page says the old registered URI list migrated to HL7 Terminology, and hierarchy.xml includes the page under Terminology.
evidence_items.learned: Current FHIR core build scope delegates active identifier registry content to THO rather than listing NPI locally.

evidence_items.summary: THO NamingSystem/npi is active, titled United States National Provider Identifier, and has preferred URI http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-npi plus OID 2.16.840.1.113883.4.6.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative registry still contains the URI requested by FHIR-8047.

evidence_items.summary: The current Practitioner general examples include an NPI identifier with system http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-npi.
evidence_items.learned: Current core examples use the requested system URI consistently.
